newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and the pound on Thursday, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.1265 on Thursday from 20.0035 on Wednesday. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.8765 for one pound from 32.7075 on Wednesday.
Dealers said the weaker rupee on Thursday reflected the strong dollar in overnight international markets.
